name: smwmusic-stardew-valley-the-wind-can-be-still
title: Stardew Valley - The Wind Can Be Still
description:
This is a very slow and relaxing theme from Stardew Valley. It sounds "cold". In the game, it plays during the winter season, so I'd probably use this port for an area just as similar.

EXTRA NOTES: This is exactly how it was in Idol 9 round 3. I should mention that this port does NOT loop. It just ends, like the original SMW credits theme.
